note: ORPHAN Pro 6:9 — how long will you lie there, O sluggard? When will you arise?

dims.v: sloth — the lazy man who will not rouse himself from sleep
the sluggard who lies abed and will not arise — sloth that clings to sleep and must be summoned to wake, the inertia that cannot rouse itself to the day's work
the laziness that lingers in bed past all reason

atsel (sluggard) — 'how long will you lie there, O SLUGGARD? When will you arise from your sleep?' (6:9); sloth is an inertia that clings to sleep. The sluggard must be roused; he will not rouse himself (cf 6:10-11; 26:14).
